reviewScope: Complete platform intrinsic, array/enum storage and native-library writer read; physical review only.
reviewNotes: Array storage domains and allocation guards, enum borrowed fixed copies, process capture and environment results read.
Socket endpoint descriptors, synchronous operations, completion affine owner submission/return graph and result cleanup read.
Async and synchronous owned file ABI, scalar validity, buffer bounds, target width conversions and runtime task layout read.
Path/directory dispatch, sequential tryParallel collection/drop logic, canonical element storage and native library names/globals/init/cleanup read.
reviewConcerns: Enum borrowed fixed payload copy still allocates without the common guard; correlate existing copy-allocation review findings before classification.
Several socket options derive nominal field types from stored receiver IDs while value writers unwrap references; need CSharp-first borrowed receiver controls before any change.
Scalar File.writeAt appears to store Bool as i1 whereas binary generic path explicitly widens i8; establish actual emitted encoding/roundtrip before defect registration.
Native string symbol metadata uses decoded length but byte emission loops raw token bytes; compare escape admission and CSharp emitted symbol constants before changing.
